title: SPP Accountability Providers
description: Service provider metadata for the ENS Service Provider Program (SPP).

programs.description: SPP program definitions keyed by program ID (e.g., SPP1, SPP2).

providers.description: List of all service providers across all programs.

year1Quarters.description: Quarters in the first year of the program. All providers report in these.

year2Quarters.description: Quarters in the second year. Only providers with streamDuration: 2 report in these.

forumUrl.description: Link to the governance proposal forum post.

voteUrl.description: Link to the on-chain governance vote (e.g., Tally).

proposalUrl.description: Link to this provider's application or nomination for the program.

streamDuration.description: Stream duration in years. Providers with 2 report in year2Quarters.

name.description: Display name of the service provider.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Used for report folders (YEAR/slug/) and avatar files (avatars/slug.ext).

programs.description: Program participation keyed by program ID. Keys must match a key in the top-level programs object.
